basics.name: Indemmity Lamare.PM
basics.summary:
Motivated MBA graduate in Healthcare Management with hands-on
Management. Proven ability to support healthcare quality initiatives
aligned with NABH, JCI, and HIPAA standards, including SOP
development, audits, and performance tracking. Demonstrated
leadership in strategic business simulations, applying project planning
and analytics to improve healthcare outcomes. Proficient in
data-driven tools such as Power BI and EMR systems. Actively seeking
an entry-level role in Project Management or Quality Assurance
to contribute to operational excellence and continuous quality
improvement in healthcare settings.
